description: Kungliga Tekniska högskolan: wastewater datasets is a collection of datasets listed in Sweden's data portal, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Kungliga Tekniska högskolan. Coverage: Kungliga Tekniska högskolan. The listing groups 6 datasets under this publisher or service host whose titles are about wastewater; the first few are linked and all are named in the audit file. Examples: Monitoring quality of sewer renewal using polymeric systems in Sweden ; Experimental evaluation of a rubber-epoxy polymeric system used in the; Field investigation to assess performance of polymeric lining used in ; Durability Evaluation of Reinforced Glass-Flake Polyester Material Use. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support water network and flood-defence studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-oppnadata.
